_comment: ADR-004 scout candidate pool. Ranked shortlist for a Critic cut — never canon. Not a signed editorial entry (those live in data/editorial/). Forbidden on every candidate and on this document: stars, reference, matrix, text. Ordinal rank only; never a 0–3 aggregate. Status promoted-to-cut records an already-assessed cut; it does not promote. why_in / why_out: short; null when N/A; at least one required. Stance is a tag, not Dictionnaire prose.
note: Ordinal scout ranks only. Never stars/Référence/matrix.

candidates.identity: artists / label / year / MBID lock — the identity string
candidates.why_in: short reason this belongs on the cut, or null
candidates.why_out: short reason this is held or rejected, or null
